headline: Keep student records in one place.
linkedin:
Student Management System is a browser-based dashboard project I worked on to keep academic records, attendance, and grades together in one interface.

Because it is built purely as a local demo using sample data, it is not configured as a production service for handling actual student data. You can inspect the project structure or test the dashboard directly.

Demo: https://sourav-bwn.github.io/student-manage-system/
Code: https://github.com/sourav-bwn/student-manage-system
